Pattern-Interrupt Curiosity Trap

  • Prevalence: Pattern-interrupt hooks drive the highest average view count of any hook type at 36.1M avg plays (12% of winners).

High-Tactile POV Demo-Tease for the Toddla Montessori Busy Board.

Why: 1. Data dominance: POV is the single most dominant format in the dataset by a wide margin (58% of winners, 22.2M avg plays), and demo-tease is the top-performing hook type (25% share, 19.8M avg plays). The exact combo `demo-tease / pov / trending-sound / 0-1s` is the #1 repeated winning formula. 2. Instant product-market fit: 88% of all viral videos reveal the product in seconds 0-1. The Toddla Montessori Busy Board’s physical features (snaps, buckles, gears, zippers) offer immediate visual and tactile gratification in the first frame, allowing us to hit the 0-1s reveal rule naturally without fluff.
